title: Extinction Rebellion / Rebellion Week climate actions crossing Sep–Oct
notes: CBA chronology says Rebellion Week ran 26 Sep–4 Oct, with decentralized demonstrations/actions and road blockades and a stated aim of pressuring leaders to cooperate on climate crisis mitigation. It began before the assigned month and ends 4 Oct; the chronology does not give each October action’s crowd/date, so no separate 1–4 Oct event is coded here. Do not merge with the distinct 23 Oct IV blockade.
